items.text: Puka Nacua listed GTD/OPTIMISM pregame and officially ACTIVE vs Raiders despite calf injury.
items.why: ETR weekend summary and official active confirmation
items.implication: Full or near-full WR1 usage expected; no major snap loss
items.opportunity: Routes and targets as WR1 in LAR offense

items.text: Breece Hall GTD/PESSIMISM and ruled INACTIVE; Braelon Allen handled ground work.
items.implication: Zero Week 7 production; monitor Week 8 practice for return

items.text: Saquon Barkley EXPECTED TO PLAY then confirmed ACTIVE; postgame said hamstring 'came out great' and back not expected to sideline him.
items.why: ETR pregame + official active + Schefter postgame comments
items.implication: Gutsy efficient outing; RB1 usage continues ROS barring setback

items.text: Jonah Coleman LOVE/upgrade: first game back led Broncos backfield 50% snaps, 41% rush, 34% routes; Dobbins only 21% snaps, Harvey fluky TD.
items.implication: Clear lead back emerging; roster in all leagues
items.opportunity: Snap share expansion, rush/route participation over Dobbins/Harvey

items.text: Jahmyr Gibbs ankle turned on purposeful slide but almost certainly fine; initial pain went away, Campbell says should be good.
items.why: Levitan assessment post-ETR watch list; player/coach comments
items.implication: No missed time expected; continues RB1 pace (Lions PPG leader)

items.text: Lamar Jackson OUT (high ankle); still has pain on cuts/sprints, chance for Week 8 depends on practice.
items.why: ETR weekend OUT list; multi-week high ankle
items.implication: Huntley continues; monitor Wed-Fri practice for Week 8 vs BUF

items.text: DeVonta Smith OUT (hamstring) alongside Dontayvion Wicks.
items.implication: PHI WR depth thinned; slot/others elevated in passing game

items.text: Dontayvion Wicks OUT; paired with Smith absence opens PHI slot opportunities.
items.implication: Temporary boost to other PHI pass-catchers

items.text: Josh Jacobs IN/activated and expected to play in return.
items.why: ETR IN list + Schefter activated expected to play
items.implication: Resumes lead back role; ROS workhorse value
items.opportunity: Carries, red-zone, snap share as GB RB1

items.text: Tank Dell IN/ACTIVE for first game since 2024 knee injury; limited routes (6) on return.
items.why: ETR IN + Schefter actives; long rehab complete
items.implication: Eased-in role; monitor snap ramp vs crowded HOU WR room

items.text: Bucky Irving not talked about enough as true workhorse RB.
items.implication: Start with confidence; high snap/carry share

items.text: Zay Flowers leads NFL in YPRR despite 64% targets from Huntley; Ravens 6th in YPP with Huntley 50% snaps. Excited for unlock with healthy Lamar.
items.implication: Massive ceiling boost when Lamar returns; already efficient

items.text: Ashton Jeanty epitome of high-value-touch thesis: worst runner (dead last YPC 3.1, poor EPA/RYOE) yet RB13 full-PPR PPG via 9 inside-5 carries + league-leading 45 RB targets.
items.why: Volume and scoring opportunity data despite efficiency woes
items.implication: Sustainable fantasy floor via goal-line/targets even if YPC stays low
items.opportunity: Inside-5 carries, targets, HVT share in LV backfield
items.conflict: Efficiency metrics terrible vs fantasy output

items.text: Nico Collins led Texans WR routes 24 on 29 Stroud dropbacks; Tank Dell only 6 in return, Noel 15 (left early turf toe).
items.implication: Clear alpha WR1 role intact; Dell ramp will be gradual
items.opportunity: Route share, targets as HOU WR1
